title: Pgbouncer And Prepared Statements Level C1
success_criteria: Uses PostgreSQL evidence rather than unsupported assertion.
Names the core-first alternative or not-yet boundary.
Includes a verification step tied to the workload signal.
oral_defense_prompts: What evidence distinguishes the diagnosis from a plausible guess?
What would you monitor after the change?
What would make not yet the more responsible recommendation?
